model_output:
```sql
WITH viewpoint_geom AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-118.320457 34.131243)'), 4326)::geometry AS geom
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS viewpoints_above_400m
FROM 
  viewpoint_geom vg,
  public.dem_us r
WHERE 
  ST_Intersects(r.rast, vg.geom)
  AND ST_Value(r.rast, 1, vg.geom) > 400;
```
